in_marathi.name: Arunaashi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arunaashi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aruna is the name of the Goddess of Dawn in Hindu mythology. The suffix ‘Aashi’ means ‘that which is’. So, Arunaashi is the one who personifies the dawn.
